dict.string: Kaizen uses the microphone only while you use Dictate, to turn what you say into text for a note or journal entry.
Kaizen turns what you say into text when you use Dictate. Kaizen doesn't keep any recording.
Kaizen uses the camera only if you choose to take a new profile photo. The photo stays on your phone.
Kaizen opens your photos only so you can pick a profile photo. It stays on your phone.
